## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest coherent solution.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Automated tests pass
- [ ] Debug build passes
- [ ] Release-relevant checks pass, or are explicitly marked unavailable
- [ ] UI changes were checked in light and dark mode
- [ ] Accessibility and keyboard behavior were considered

## File and privacy safety

- [ ] Original user files are never overwritten, modified, moved, or deleted
- [ ] Generated outputs use collision-safe names
- [ ] No document contents, cookies, credentials, private URLs, or sensitive filenames are logged
- [ ] No shell command is constructed from user input

## Licensing

- [ ] New bundled dependencies have pinned versions, source URLs, licenses, notices, and corresponding-source information where required
- [ ] Boring Notch attribution and existing copyright notices remain intact

## Visual evidence

Add sanitized screenshots or recordings for visible changes. Use generated or public-domain fixtures only.
